issues.title: Incorrect total transactions calculation
issues.problem: The subquery is incorrectly calculating total transactions for each merchant, leading to inaccurate results.
issues.fix: Remove the subquery and use a single query with GROUP BY.

issues.title: Potential performance issue with subquery
issues.problem: The correlated subquery can be inefficient as it runs for each row in the result set.
issues.fix: Remove the subquery and use a single query with GROUP BY.

issues.title: Lack of comments
issues.problem: The query lacks comments explaining the logic and purpose.
issues.fix: Add comments to explain the query logic.

review.corrected_sql: SELECT m.MERCHANT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS TXN_COUNT, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.MERCHANT_ID) AS TOTAL_TXNS FROM FACT_TRANSACTIONS t JOIN DIM_MERCHANT m ON t.MERCHANT_ID = m.MERCHANT_ID WHERE t.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY m.MERCHANT_NAME, t.MERCHANT_ID ORDER BY TXN_COUNT DESC;
review.summary: The query had correctness issues with the subquery, potential performance issues, and lacked readability due to missing comments.
